The beetle exhibits a vibrant emerald green exoskeleton with iridescent qualities. Its head is distinct from the thorax, featuring large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Long, thin antennae extend forward and outward. Six slender legs are visible, gripping the uneven surface. A strong shadow is cast to the right, indicating directional lighting.
